g.text: 第 r 行按 r / H 插值

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', 'SimHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0e1b2b

g.text: s = x − B：零件带坐标，之后不变
